about: The shared commands of the application. A shared command does nothing by itself: a plugin handles it with an entry of contributes.handlers and registers the handler under the id of the command. Run over a target, a command with one matching handler runs it, and a command with several offers the matching handlers as its items. `arguments` are declared once, as a manifest command declares them; the palette asks for them and the core checks them for every handler. tools/commands.mjs writes the Go and TypeScript lists from this file. `windowCommands` are the commands of the window that take arguments, declared the same way, with `values` the allowed values of an argument as text; the entry of a slot that passes values to a command of the window is checked against them, and a command of the window not listed takes none.
